title.en: No leftover markers in the code

summary.en: A TODO, FIXME or XXX left in a comment, or an unfinished-content marker like lorem ipsum, means the file was delivered unfinished.

en: A note-to-self was left in the code.
I am resolving it, so nothing half-finished ships.
fr: Une note laissée dans le code allait rester.
Je la traite, pour ne rien livrer d'inachevé.

reason.en: A leftover marker was found in a comment: a TODO, FIXME or XXX, or an unfinished-content marker such as lorem ipsum, 'a compléter', 'inserer' or changeme. Resolve what it stands for and remove the marker; a delivered file is complete and runnable, not a note about what is left to do.
